rule: These are evidence-backed investigation priorities, not final root-cause declarations. Reconfirm on the exact live candidate with the new read-only layer/weights/skinning diagnostics before any edit.

hypotheses.symptom: lateral/back wing or lobe through overhead elevation
observations: r91 retained analysis identified lateral/back wing vertices with approximately spine_02 0.55 + scapula_l 0.45 weights and 5-6.5 cm weights-only outward displacement.
The retained analysis explicitly classified that wing as a skin-WEIGHT effect, unlike the corrective-caused chest pit/knob.
r95 reduced lobe-zone maximum outward offsets at overhead states but did not prove the underlying multi-anchor torso/scapula/humerus ownership was anatomically correct.
first_tests: RUN_ORIGINAL_V1_SKINNING_AB_AUDIT.bat only if formulation remains plausible contributor
hypotheses.forbidden_inference: Do not copy the old r91 weight values into a new declaration without exact-candidate confirmation.

hypotheses.symptom: chest pit / pectoral collapse / clavicle-top web or knob
observations: r95 abduction corrective moves 1229 vertices per side with maximum stored delta about 7.184 cm.
r95 flexion corrective covers 1491 vertices per side with maximum delta about 2.799 cm.
r95 scapular corrective moves 234 vertices per side with maximum delta about 5.282 cm.
r95 retained dent/volume sweep reaches roughly 7 cm inward dent around 145 degrees and about 1.45% whole-mesh volume loss in the same overhead range.
hypotheses.repair_rule: Do not refit or add a corrective until the weights-only shared-tissue path clears.

hypotheses.symptom: sharp step at boundary of r95 lobe correction
observations: r95 lobe correction reduces high-elevation outward offset from roughly 7.6-9.34 cm in r93 to roughly 4.03-4.51 cm.
The same evidence reports new boundary steps growing to about 1.64-1.74 cm in overhead pull/press states.
Minimum edge-ratio values in several overhead samples are slightly worse after the lobe correction, consistent with a trade-off rather than a clean anatomical solution.
hypotheses.repair_rule: A smaller lobe is not acceptance if a boundary step/trench replaces it.

hypotheses.symptom: base joint volume/twist artifact that persists after local ownership repair
observations: No retained r95 evidence proves LBS or Preserve Volume/DQ globally superior for the whole body.
hypotheses.repair_rule: Do not switch global skinning mode from one shoulder pose; selection requires whole-body visual/regression evidence.

hypotheses.symptom: persistent local collapse after kinematics/weights/skinning are shown plausible
observations: The r91 retained analysis found no inverted/collapsed triangles in the investigated zone and explicitly ranked topology/rig changes below weight/corrective repairs.
first_tests: weights-only visual proof after ownership repair
hypotheses.repair_rule: Reopen topology only if a corrected base-weight path still cannot form human compression/sliding without collapse.

note: Historical r91/r95 evidence narrows investigation; it does not authorize editing or closure. The exact current candidate must be re-audited.
